data.narrative:
Zephyr Fusion is a pre-seed-stage nuclear energy company founded by two plasma physics researchers with 15+ and 20+ years of experience respectively at national laboratories and major research universities. The broader nuclear energy sector comp universe includes 3 public companies (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 7 private firms, though only 1 private peer operates at an adjacent stage to Zephyr's current position.

Stage-progression methodology is the applicable valuation approach here. Using the $500K total raised as a proxy for current implied value and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Pre-Seed to next-stage progression yields $1.25M. This method reflects market convention for advancing from pre-seed to seed/Series A without relying on sparse peer comparables. Peer-median methodology cannot be reliably applied due to insufficient comparable transactions at Zephyr's stage within nuclear energy; while 6 same-sector peers exist (Helion, Oklo, Valar Atomics, X-Energy, Nano Nuclear Energy, and public comps), constructing a narrow peer set of 3+ same-stage or adjacent-stage companies proved infeasible.

The triangulated valuation range is $1.06M to $1.44M, with a median of $1.25M. This analysis reflects a single methodology and therefore carries material uncertainty around appropriate step-up multiples for pre-seed stage progression in capital-intensive frontier energy. Key uncertainties include technology risk validation milestones and trajectory toward Series A fundraising.
